tax.profit.ivao_rate.note: IVAO: tax on operational revenue for eligible SMEs, in place of profit tax.

tax.dividend.rate.note: The 2027 bill (approved by Government 8 September 2026, not adopted) keeps 6% in art. 90^1 alin. (3^1) lit. a) for profits generated before 2027 and sets 8% for profits generated from 2027. A profit-vintage rule, not a payment-date rule.

tax.vat.registration_threshold.note: Art. 112 alin. (1) and (4): raised from MDL 1,200,000 to MDL 1,500,000 from 1 January 2026 by Law 318/2025, and again to MDL 1,700,000 from 1 March 2026 (md-2026.2). Measured over the last 12 consecutive months, not a calendar year, so an entity can cross it at any point; that wording of art. 112 is not read yet.

tax.vat.deduction_requires_electronic_in.note: Art. 102 para (18), which restricted the right to deduct VAT on a non-electronic invoice issued by a supplier on the mandatory e-Factura list, is ABROGATED from 1 January 2026. So from 2026 a paper invoice from a list-obligated supplier no longer costs the buyer its deduction. This materially reduces the commercial pressure to adopt e-Factura and must not be modelled as a blocking validation.

tax.vat.refund_ceiling_efactura_or_mev.note: Not in the Fiscal Code: the Regulation approved by HG 93/2013, pct. 47^3 subpct. 1), caps the refund under art. 101^6 at a share of the VAT that buyers paid, documented through SIA e-Factura and through cash registers connected to MEV. HG 496/2025 raised that share from 20% to 70%, in force on publication, 14 August 2025, so it was already 70% before 2026.

efactura.obligation.basis.text: art. 117 para (1^1) risk-based list; art. 117 para (14) since 2025-01-01
efactura.obligation.basis.note: There is NO universal B2B mandate in force. Obligation arises in these cases: B2G and public procurement (art. 117 alin. (12), restated by Law 187/2025 from 18 July 2025); supplies to economic agents on Moldovan territory without fiscal relations with its budget system (art. 117 alin. (14), Law 214/2024, since 1 January 2025); supplies for the projects of art. 104 lit. c^1) (art. 117 alin. (15)); and inclusion on the SFS risk-based list (art. 117 alin. (1^1), Order SFS 645/2018), changed by SFS Orders 141/2026 and 494/2026. The list size, reported at 69 entities, is from secondary sources.

efactura.mandatory_list.selection_min_cr.note: An entity is added when SFS finds it meets at least three criteria at once („întrunesc concomitent cel puțin trei criterii”). Order SFS 645/2018 lists criteria a) to h); an SFS order of 8 June 2022 reportedly added i) and j), making ten, found only in secondary sources.

efactura.mandatory_list.significant_supp.note: Criterion a) of Order SFS 645/2018: supplies of at least 500 thousand lei a month without material or human assets (fewer than 2 employees), over the last 3 months.

payroll.income_tax.personal_deduction_an.note: Scutirea personală (art. 33 alin. (1)): 29,700 since 1 January 2025, when Law 214/2024 replaced 27,000; unchanged for 2026. Granted monthly as one twelfth from the month after the employee asks for it (HG 697/2014 pct. 18), at one place of work of the employee's choosing: the main job, a second job, where services are provided, or dual education (pct. 9-10), and never at two.

payroll.income_tax.personal_deduction_in.note: Art. 33 alin. (1): the exemption belongs to a resident whose annual taxable income is under 360,000, art. 90^1 income excepted; from 2026 art. 33 alin. (1^1) counts chapter 10^2 and 10^3 income too. The test is the year's taxable income from every source, not one employer's salary. Art. 88 alin. (1), completed by Law 214/2024: 'Angajatorul nu are obligația să urmărească pierderea dreptului de utilizare a scutirii personale.' Whoever used it and earned more files the annual return (art. 83 alin. (2) lit. a^2)). The product today withdraws the whole year's exemption, cumulatively, from the month salary paid here passes the cap; the act does not ask for that. To be decided by the compliance owner. Dependant exemptions (art. 35) are not lost with it.

payroll.cnas.employer_rate.note: Law 489/1999 annex 1 pct. 1.1, as restated by Law 60/2020 from 1 January 2021: 24% of the salaries and rewards computed each month, for private-sector employers and higher-education and medical institutions ('învățământ superior', not all public education). Budget and public-authority employers pay 29%, not encoded. Law 320/2025, the 2026 social insurance budget, carries no rate.

payroll.cnas.employee_rate.note: Law 60/2020 abrogated art. 21 of Law 489/1999, the individual contribution, from 1 January 2021, so contributions are paid entirely by the employer. The 6% figure that circulates in secondary sources applies only to specific categories (daily remuneration for certain workers) and must be modelled as a category-specific exception, not a general rate.

payroll.cnam.employee_rate.note: Prima de asigurare obligatorie de asistență medicală as a percentage of salary, withheld from the employee: 9.0% for 2026 under Law 321/2025 art. 4 alin. (1); Law 212/2026 amended that law without changing it. Deducted from the employee's income before income tax (payroll.income_tax.medical_premium_deductible). No minimum base found.

itpark.single_tax.rate.note: Art. 370 alin. (1): 7% of sales revenue, not less than the minimum per employee. Replaces profit tax, payroll income tax, CNAS and CNAM; VAT applies separately. SFS's Q&A 37.5 (Order SFS 119/2024) still counts local taxes, property tax and road tax among the taxes it replaces (art. 372 alin. (1)); the earlier note that they are paid separately from 2026 was found only in a 2023 draft.

itpark.single_tax.min_per_employee_month.note: Art. 370 alin. (2), per SFS's Q&A 37.3: 30% of the forecast average monthly wage, per employee: 30% of 17,400 is 5,220. Recomputed annually.

filing.tva12.due_day_of_month.note: Art. 115 alin. (1), as quoted by SFS: no later than the 25th of the month after the tax period. That it shifts to the next working day when the 25th is a weekend or holiday is not read yet.

filing.iu17.due_day_of_month.note: Art. 373, as quoted by SFS: by the 25th of the month after the month of management.

filing.ven12.due_date.note: Art. 83 alin. (2) lit. c), as quoted by SFS: by the 25th of the third month after the end of the fiscal period, so 25 March when the fiscal year is the calendar year.

document.factura_fiscala.form_order.note: Strict-regime standardised form with state-issued series and number. From 1 January 2026 OMF 135/2025 adds the mention „Taxare inversă” for supplies under art. 101^7; OMF 47/2026 makes signatures optional on utility invoices.

register.general_invoice_register.in_for.note: Art. 118^1 of the Fiscal Code, which required invoices above MDL 100,000 to be registered in the Registrul general electronic al facturilor fiscale, was abrogated from 1 January 2020 by Law 171/2019. Do not implement it.

tax.vat.reduced_rate.note: Art. 96 lit. b). Read in the amending acts: accommodation, and food and non-alcoholic drinks served under section I of the classifier (HoReCa), at 8% since 10 August 2023 (Law 212/2023 art. II pct. 22 replaced 12%, source 13), so no 12% rate applies in 2026; natural gas and liquefied gas at 2711 with their transport and distribution (Law 139/2025, from 2026); medical devices in the State Register (Law 187/2025, from 2026). From secondary sources only: bread and bakery products, milk and dairy products at the listed positions, medicines at 3001-3004, agricultural produce in natural form. The 2027 bill would bring HoReCa back to 12%.

tax.vat.zero_rate.note: Art. 104: supplies taxed at zero with the right to deduct input VAT (exports, among others); Law 139/2025 added lit. b^1), imports of gas and electricity through networks, from 2026. Distinct from exempt supplies under art. 103, which carry no VAT and no right to deduct; the product names those as exempt rather than as a rate. The general text of art. 104 was not read.

tax.vat.line_rounding.note: VAT is computed per invoice line and rounded to two decimals (tax.vat.line_rounding_decimals). Half away from zero is ordinary commercial rounding; konta-efactura currently rounds half to even. The two must agree with what SIA e-Factura computes, to be confirmed on the first round trip with a test account.

tax.vat.line_rounding_decimals.note: Lei and bani: amounts on an invoice have two decimals.

ledger.sales.receivable_account.note: Chapter III: account 221 Creanțe comerciale is debited for goods and services sold, in correspondence with 611 and 534. A company may post to its subaccounts instead.

ledger.sales.revenue_account.note: Chapter III: account 611 Venituri din vînzări is credited for sales. The default for an invoice line; a line may name another revenue account or subaccount.

ledger.sales.vat_account.note: Chapter III: account 534 Datorii față de buget is credited for VAT charged on sales (subaccount 5344 in the act).

ledger.purchases.payable_account.note: Chapter III: 521 Datorii comerciale curente is credited in correspondence with 211, 213, 713 and others as goods and services are received, and debited in correspondence with 242 and others as they are paid. A company may post to its subaccounts instead.

ledger.purchases.vat_account.note: Chapter III prescribes neither choice. 521's credit lists no 534 and no 225; 534 is debited in correspondence with 225 among others, and 225 is debited against 534, so holding deductible VAT on 2252 Creanțe privind TVA and offsetting it against 5344 is the act's own path. Debiting 534 (5344) directly, as the product does, is common Moldovan practice. To be decided by the compliance owner. VAT that cannot be deducted is not posted here but added to the cost of what was bought.

ledger.payments.bank_account.note: Chapter III: account 242 Conturi curente în monedă națională is debited for money received into a current account in correspondence with 221 among others, and credited for money paid out in correspondence with 521 among others. The default for a bank payment in the company's currency; a payment may name a subaccount (2421) or another account the company keeps its money on.

payroll.income_tax.dependant_deduction_a.note: Art. 35 alin. (1): 9,900 a year per dependant since 2025 (Law 214/2024 replaced 9,000), unchanged for 2026. The higher amount is payroll.income_tax.dependant_deduction_disability_annual; a person with income above payroll.income_tax.dependant_income_ceiling_annual is not a dependant.

payroll.income_tax.withholding_method.note: HG 697/2014 pct. 38, as restated by HG 1029/2023: taxable income and the tax are computed cumulatively from the start of the fiscal year, or from the date of hiring. The fișa personală floors the year's taxable income at zero (column 7.8), but the month's tax is the difference between the last two cumulative figures (column 7.10, 'reținerii (rambursării)'), so a month can give back tax withheld earlier. The product never refunds through payroll today: to be decided by the compliance owner. Exemptions accumulate for every month the person counts as employed, whether or not salary was paid (column 7.5).

payroll.income_tax.medical_premium_deduc.note: Codul fiscal art. 35^2 alin. (1), added by Law 212/2023 from 1 January 2024: 'Se permite deducerea, în cuantumurile stabilite de legislație, a sumelor pentru primele de asigurare obligatorie de asistență medicală achitate de persoanele fizice'. HG 697/2014's fișa personală deducts it in column 7.7. SFS's worked example: gross 10,000; premium 900; exemption 2,475; taxable 6,625; tax 795.

payroll.rounding.note: No rounding rule was found in the acts read: HG 1029/2023 rewrote the fișa personală's instructions, and the whole-lei rule that secondary sources describe is not in the new text. Bani throughout, half away from zero, is our choice. To be confirmed by the compliance owner.

payroll.minimum_wage.monthly.note: Salariul minim pe țară from 1 January 2026, for a full programme of 169 hours a month on average (37.28 lei an hour). Up from 5,500.

payroll.average_wage.forecast_monthly.note: Salariul mediu lunar pe economie prognozat pentru 2026, approved by the Government on 17 December 2025 (up from 16,100). Used as a ceiling in several tax rules, none of them built yet.

ledger.payroll.salaries_payable_account.note: Chapter III: 531 Datorii față de personal privind retribuirea muncii is credited for salaries in correspondence with 712, 713, 714, 811 and others, and debited in correspondence with 533 and 534 for what is withheld and with 242 for what is paid out. Subaccount 5311 Datorii salariale.

ledger.payroll.social_insurance_account.note: Chapter III: 533 is credited for contributions in correspondence with the expense accounts. Subaccount 5331 Datorii față de bugetul asigurărilor sociale de stat, for the employer's CNAS contribution.

ledger.payroll.medical_insurance_account.note: Chapter III: 533 is credited in correspondence with 531 for the premium withheld. Subaccount 5332 Datorii față de fondurile asigurării obligatorii de asistență medicală.

ledger.payroll.income_tax_account.note: Chapter III: 534 is credited in correspondence with 531 for tax withheld. Subaccount 5342 Datorii privind impozitul pe venit din salariu.

ledger.payroll.expense_account.note: The default expense for a salary and its CNAS contribution, administrative (713). Chapter III lets 531 correspond with 712, 713, 714, 811, 812 and others; which one is the employee's function, so each employee may name their own. The default is a convenience, not a rule of the act.

payroll.income_tax.major_personal_deduct.note: Scutirea personală majoră, Codul fiscal art. 33 alin. (2), read on legis.md on 22.10.2026: 'Suma scutirii personale, stabilită la alin.(1), va constitui 34620 lei pe an pentru orice persoană care:' lit. a)-f): actinic illness from the Chernobyl accident, or a disability causally linked to it; the parent or spouse of a participant fallen or missing in the fighting for Moldova's territorial integrity and independence or in Afghanistan; a disability from that fighting; a war disability, a congenital or childhood disability, a severe or accentuated disability; a pensioner who was a victim of political repression, since rehabilitated. It is the personal exemption of alin. (1) at a higher amount, so it is granted in place of the ordinary one and under the same condition, a year's taxable income under payroll.income_tax.personal_deduction_income_cap. 34,620 since 2025 (Law 214/2024 replaced 31,500); the same figure in the versions in force on 1 January 2026, 25 June 2026 and 1 January 2027. The product grants it from the month the employee asks for it from (HG 697/2014 pct. 18, as the personal exemption), in the months it is owed in place of the ordinary amount, and withdraws it with the personal exemption above the cap.

payroll.income_tax.spouse_deduction_annu.note: Codul fiscal art. 34 alin. (2), read on legis.md on 22.10.2026: 'Persoana fizică rezidentă aflată în relaţii de căsătorie cu orice persoană specificată la art.33 alin.(2) are dreptul la o scutire suplimentară în sumă de 21780 lei anual, cu condiţia că soţia (soţul) nu beneficiază de scutire personală.' Alin. (1), a spouse exemption for everybody, is abrogated. Alin. (3): it applies 'din luna următoare lunii în care au apărut circumstanțele necesare'. 21,780 since 2025 (Law 214/2024 replaced 19,800); the same figure in the versions in force on 1 January 2026, 25 June 2026 and 1 January 2027. Art. 34 does not repeat the 360,000 condition of art. 33 alin. (1), so the product keeps this exemption above the cap, as it keeps the dependant exemption: to be confirmed by the compliance owner.

payroll.income_tax.dependant_deduction_d.note: Art. 35 alin. (1), the higher amount per dependant: 21,780 since 2025 (Law 214/2024 replaced 19,800). That it covers severe or accentuated, congenital or childhood disability comes from secondary sources. Not used by the product yet.

payroll.income_tax.dependant_income_ceil.note: Art. 35 alin. (2) lit. b): a person whose own annual income is above this is not a dependant. 12,400 since 2025 (Law 214/2024 replaced 11,280). Not used by the product yet.

tax.profit.ivao_revenue_ceiling.note: Art. 54^1 alin. (3) lit. a) and (3^1): 1.2 million became 1.5 million from 1 January 2026 (Law 318/2025). Read as the IVAO regime's revenue ceiling from the amending text; the consolidated wording is not read. Law 12/2026 moved the VAT threshold to 1.7 million from March but this figure stayed: to be confirmed by the compliance owner.

ledger.advances.received_account.note: Chapter III: account 523 Avansuri primite curente is credited for advances received in correspondence with 241, 242, 243 among others, and debited when they are settled in correspondence with 221 among others (subaccounts 5231 from Moldova, 5232 from abroad). Read in the ministry's PDF of OMF 119/2013 (SHA-256 0b2271eb...), 17.10.2026.

ledger.advances.paid_account.note: Chapter III: account 224 Avansuri acordate curente is debited for advances paid in correspondence with 241, 242, 243 among others, and credited when they are settled in correspondence with 521 among others (subaccounts 2241-2244 by what the advance is for). Read in the ministry's PDF of OMF 119/2013, 17.10.2026.

ledger.advances.received_vat_account.note: Where the VAT due on an advance received waits until the supply: chapter III debits account 225 Creanțe ale bugetului in correspondence with 534 among others and credits it in correspondence with 534 (subaccount 2252, VAT). Debited against ledger.sales.vat_account when the advance is received, credited back in each settlement's share, since the invoice charges VAT on the whole supply. The act lists the correspondence, not this use of it: the usual practice, to be confirmed by the compliance owner.

tax.vat.advance_received_taxable.note: Codul fiscal art. 108 alin. (5): 'Dacă factura fiscală este eliberată sau plata este primită până la momentul efectuării livrării, data livrării se consideră data eliberării facturii fiscale sau data primirii plăţii, în dependenţă de ce are loc mai înainte.' So VAT is due on an advance received, at the supply's rate. Read on legis.md in the version as amended by Law 112/2026 (in force 25.06.2026), 17.10.2026. Alin. (6)-(8) set other dates for regular supplies, leasing and services settled by acts of acceptance, not modelled. The buyer's deduction on an advance paid is not modelled either.

labour.working_time.daily_hours.note: Codul muncii art. 100 alin. (1): 'Durata zilnică normală a timpului de muncă constituie 8 ore', within art. 95 alin. (2)'s 40 hours a week. Shorter days for minors, harmful conditions and disability (art. 96, art. 100 alin. (2)-(4)) are not modelled. A month's norm in hours is this times its working days, less payroll's pre-holiday reduction.

labour.working_time.pre_holiday_reductio.note: Codul muncii art. 102 alin. (1): the working day before a non-working public holiday 'se reduce cu cel puţin o oră' for everybody but those already on reduced time (art. 96) or part time (art. 97). At least one hour: alin. (3) leaves the exact length to the collective agreement, the internal rules or the employer's order, which a company cannot set in Konta yet. Alin. (2): a transferred eve keeps the reduction.

payroll.proration.method.note: A monthly salary for part of a month (hired or leaving mid-month, unpaid leave) is the salary times the days worked over the month's working days from calendar/md-holidays.json. Codul muncii art. 128 alin. (1) pays salary for work done and art. 97 alin. (3) pays part time 'proporţional timpului lucrat'; no act read prescribes working days rather than hours or calendar days for an incomplete month. Working days is our choice, the usual practice: to be confirmed by the compliance owner.

labour.leave.annual_minimum_days.note: Codul muncii art. 113 alin. (1): 'un concediu de odihnă plătit, cu o durată minimă de 28 de zile calendaristice, cu excepţia zilelor de sărbătoare nelucrătoare'. Alin. (2) and art. 121 allow longer leave by organic law or for harmful conditions, minors and severe sight disability (at least 4 more days). The product does not keep a balance of leave owed yet.

payroll.leave.days_basis.note: Annual leave is counted, and paid, in calendar days less the non-working public holidays of art. 111 that fall inside it, whatever day of the week they fall on: Codul muncii art. 113 alin. (1); HG 426/2004 anexa 1 pct. 6 subpct. 1) and pct. 14 subpct. 1) pay leave per calendar day 'la numărul zilelor de concediu exprimat în zile calendaristice'. A local patron saint's day (art. 111 alin. (1) lit. j)) is not subtracted: it holds only in its locality. The Ministry of Labour's draft to count leave in working days from 2027 was not law on 18.10.2026.

payroll.leave.pay_month.note: Codul muncii art. 117 alin. (3), as consolidated on legis.md (read 18.10.2026): leave pay is paid 'cu cel puțin 3 zile calendaristice înainte de începerea concediului sau la o dată agreată de părți, dar nu mai târziu de data achitării salariului pentru luna în care a fost acordat concediul respectiv'. The whole leave's pay is therefore computed in the payroll of the month the leave starts, including days that fall in the next month, and taxed then (HG 697/2014 pct. 36: when directed to payment). How CNAS splits the contribution by the months the leave covers on IPC21 (Ordin CNAS 31-A/2026 pct. 8.1) is for the IPC21 work. Our reading, for the compliance owner.

payroll.average_earnings.method.note: HG 426/2004 anexa 1 pct. 5 last alineat (as amended by HG 428/2007) and pct. 10: the 3 calendar months before the month of the event (de la data de 1 pînă la data de 1); per working day, the earnings of pct. 3 over the days actually worked, leave, sick days and their pay left out; per calendar day, that times the scheduled working days over the calendar days less art. 111's holidays of the same period. A month with no work stays in the period (pct. 10 last alineat). Somebody employed less than 3 months: the period is the time worked (pct. 5, pct. 11 al. 1). The 12-month period of pct. 5 al. 2 (agriculture, teachers, piece work paid at completion, varying part time) and the seasonal one are not modelled: the product knows only this method.

payroll.average_earnings.reference_month.note: HG 426/2004 anexa 1 pct. 5 last alineat: 'ultimele 3 luni calendaristice de lucru premergătoare evenimentului de care depinde plata respectivă (de la data de 1 pînă la data de 1)'. The event is the first day of the leave or of the incapacity.

payroll.average_earnings.lookback_months.note: HG 426/2004 anexa 1 pct. 11 al. 2: with no earnings at all in the 3 months, the average comes from 'ultimele 3 luni din cele 12 luni premergătoare evenimentului de plată, în care ei au avut zile efectiv lucrate şi au avut cîştig'.

payroll.average_earnings.calendar_days_p.note: HG 426/2004 anexa 1 pct. 7: '29,4 zile – numărul mediu de zile calendaristice pe lună'. Used when no earnings exist to average (hired in the month of the event, or none in the 12 months): pct. 11 al. 4 then bases the average on the monthly salary, and pct. 14 subpt. 2) turns a calendar-day average into a month by 29,4, so the product divides the monthly salary by 29,4. That division is our reading of al. 4, for the compliance owner. Pct. 12 also divides periodic bonuses by it; the product does not tell periodic bonuses from monthly ones yet.

payroll.average_earnings.rounding.note: HG 426/2004 says nothing on rounding (the original annex and its nine amending acts read). The averages are kept exact and only the amount paid is rounded, by payroll.rounding. Professional examples (contabilsef.md, 06.12.2010) round the coefficient to 4 decimals and each average to 2, which differs by about 2 bani a leave: question for the compliance owner.

payroll.leave.study_share.note: HG 426/2004 anexa 1 pct. 14 subpt. 1), completed by HG 1025/2007: 'În cazul concediilor de studii, rezultatul căpătat se corectează la cota de menținere a salariului mediu – 75 %'.

payroll.sick.employer_days_per_case.note: Legea 289/2004 art. 4 alin. (2^1) lit. a): 'primele cinci zile calendaristice de incapacitate temporară de muncă se plătesc din mijloacele angajatorului'; from the sixth day the social insurance budget pays (lit. b)), outside the employer's payroll. Not for tuberculosis, AIDS, cancer, a risk of losing a pregnancy or a registered pregnancy, paid by the budget from the first day (alin. (3)), nor for days of unpaid leave (art. 12 alin. (2)).

payroll.sick.employer_days_per_year.note: Legea 289/2004 art. 4 alin. (2^1) lit. a): 'însă nu mai mult de 15 zile cumulative pe parcursul unui an calendaristic în cazul mai multor perioade de incapacitate temporară de muncă'. The product counts the employer's days of the year in which each incapacity starts.

payroll.sick.employer_share.note: Legea 289/2004 art. 13 alin. (3): 'în proporție de 75% din salariul mediu al angajatului, determinat în modul stabilit de Guvern', with art. 7 alin. (15); HG 426/2004 anexa 1 pct. 14 subpct. 1^1) (HG 685/2019): the calendar-day average of pct. 8 and 10 times the days of incapacity, at most 5, 'recalculat la cota de menținere a salariului mediu al angajatului – 75%'. The insured-income cap of art. 7 alin. (3) concerns the budget's base, not this one.

payroll.sick.social_contribution.note: Legea 489/1999 anexa nr. 3 pct. 19: no social contribution is calculated on 'indemnizaţia pentru incapacitate temporară de muncă', whoever pays it. Leave pay is not on the annex's list (pct. 3 even names unused-leave compensation as subject), so it carries the contribution as salary does.

payroll.sick.medical_premium.note: Legea 1593/2002 art. 6 computes the premium on salary and 'alte recompense', which art. 3 defines as any other sum the employer pays its employee except the income of Codul fiscal art. 20, 89, 90 and 90^1. Art. 20 lit. a) exempts social insurance benefits paid from the social insurance budget; the employer's first days are paid from its own means, so the premium applies. Our reading, for the compliance owner.

payroll.sick.income_tax.note: Codul fiscal art. 20 lit. a) leaves out of gross income only social insurance benefits 'achitate din bugetul asigurărilor sociale de stat'; the employer's first days are its own payment to its employee (art. 18 lit. c), o)), which it deducts (art. 36 alin. (8)). So they are taxed with the month's salary. Our reading, for the compliance owner.

ledger.cash.account.note: Chapter III, account 241 (the Ministry of Finance's consolidated PDF of OMF 119/2013, SHA-256 0b2271eb4477f8fa4af660a227669629c9162651c99d1f144feb9b6eb64764ab, PDF page 31, read 22.10.2026): 'Contul 241 “Casa” este destinat generalizării informaţiei privind existenţa şi mişcarea numerarului nelegat şi legat în casierie în monedă naţională şi valută străină.' It is debited for cash received 'în corespondenţă cu creditul conturilor: 141, 142, 161, 162, 221, 223, 224, 226, 231, 234, 241, 242, 243, 244, 245, 251, 252, 313, 314, 412, 423, 425, 512, 523, 534, 537, 611, 612, 622, 623, 832 etc.' and credited for cash paid out 'în corespondenţă cu debitul conturilor: 141, 142, 162, 224, 226, 241, 242, 243, 244, 245, 251, 252, 315, 412, 423, 512, 523, 531, 532, 536, 544, 712, 713, 714, 722, 723 etc.' (521, the supplier, is not named for cash paid out, as it is for 242; the list ends in 'etc.'). The account of a cash receipt or payment order and of the cash book; a cash order may name a subaccount the company keeps (2411 Casa în monedă națională).

ledger.cash.accountable_persons_account.note: Chapter III, account 226 Creanțe ale personalului (the same PDF, page 29, read 22.10.2026): debited 'în corespondenţă cu creditul conturilor: 241, 242, 243, 424, 535, 544, 612, 622 etc.' and credited 'în corespondenţă cu debitul conturilor: 111, 121, 132, 211, 217, 241, 531, 532, 712, 713, 714, 722 etc.'; subaccount 2261 Creanțe ale titularilor de avans (chapter II). Cash given to an accountable person (Law 34/2024 art. 7: for at most 30 days) debits it against the cash account; cash they return credits it.

cash.limits.payments_to_entities_monthly.note: Legea 34/2024 art. 5 alin. (1) lit. a), read on legis.md 22.10.2026 in the text in force from 01.04.2025 (LP55/2025 rewrote art. 5 alin. (1) lit. e) and f), not these words): 'a) să efectueze, în raport cu alte persoane juridice sau persoane fizice care desfășoară activitate de întreprinzător și/sau profesională în sectorul justiției sau în domeniul sănătății, plăți în numerar în sumă ce nu depășește cumulativ 100000 de lei lunar. Limitarea sumei respective nu se aplică pentru depunerea de numerar în conturile deschise la prestatorii de servicii de plată;' The law does not say whether 'cumulativ' adds up the payments to each recipient or to all of them; read literally, all of them. Not read by the product yet: applying it needs to know whether a partner is a person or an entity, which the partner list does not record.

cash.limits.payments_to_individuals_mont.note: Legea 34/2024 art. 5 alin. (1) lit. b), read on legis.md 22.10.2026 in the text in force from 01.04.2025 (LP55/2025 rewrote art. 5 alin. (1) lit. e) and f), not these words): 'b) să efectueze plăți în numerar în favoarea unei persoane fizice care nu desfășoară activitate de întreprinzător în sumă ce nu depășește cumulativ 100000 de lei lunar, cu excepțiile specificate la lit. c)–h);' The higher or yearly limits of lit. c)-h) (scrap, packaging, farm produce, dividends, loans) are not encoded. Not read by the product yet: applying it needs to know whether a partner is a person or an entity, which the partner list does not record.

cash.limits.receipt_from_individual_per_.note: Legea 34/2024 art. 5 alin. (1) lit. i), read on legis.md 22.10.2026 in the text in force from 01.04.2025 (LP55/2025 rewrote art. 5 alin. (1) lit. e) and f), not these words): 'i) să încaseze plăți în numerar de la o persoană fizică care nu desfășoară activitate de întreprinzător, în sumă ce nu depășește 100000 de lei pentru o plată, cu excepția situațiilor prevăzute la alin. (2) din prezentul articol.' Per payment, not cumulative. Alin. (2) sets 100 000 a year per client for the professions of art. 2 alin. (1) lit. e), not encoded. Not read by the product yet: applying it needs to know whether a partner is a person or an entity, which the partner list does not record.

cash.advances.settlement_days_max.note: Legea 34/2024 art. 7 alin. (1), read on legis.md 22.10.2026 in the text in force from 01.04.2025 (LP55/2025 rewrote art. 5 alin. (1) lit. e) and f), not these words): '(1) Pentru cheltuielile operaționale și de gospodărire, persoanele specificate la art. 2 alin. (1) lit. a)–e) eliberează numerar spre decontare în termenele stabilite de conducătorii acestora, care însă nu vor depăși 30 de zile, cu excepția cheltuielilor pentru deplasările peste hotarele Republicii Moldova.' Business trips abroad are excepted. Not read by the product yet: it does not follow when an accountable person's cash is due back.

cash.advances.return_working_days.note: Legea 34/2024 art. 7 alin. (3), read on legis.md 22.10.2026 in the text in force from 01.04.2025 (LP55/2025 rewrote art. 5 alin. (1) lit. e) and f), not these words): '(3) Numerarul eliberat spre decontare în condițiile alin. (1) și neutilizat trebuie să fie restituit în casieria entității în termen de 5 zile lucrătoare după expirarea termenului pentru care a fost eliberat.' Not read by the product yet: it does not follow when an accountable person's cash is due back.
